jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Spatial Research & Data Visualization (m/f/d) (Wirtschaftsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) About the Research Institute: The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is an applied research organization creating predictive spatial models for renewable energy siting, power grid capacities, and environmental land resilience across Germany. What We Offer: We support international applicants through every step of the German Opportunity Card process, covering visa administration, qualification recognition, local accommodation setup, and baseline cost-of-living stipends. In addition, we provide on-site German language training and a collaborative research environment working with state-of-the-art Web-GIS tools. Your Role & Key Tasks: You will analyze and validate spatial resilience outputs and energy location clusters generated by our data engine. You will create clear, interactive map presentations and automated visual factsheets using Web-GIS and dashboarding tools, acting as a vital communication link between technical data engineering and practical research applications. How to Apply: Please send your CV and a brief cover letter in English. We look forward to getting in touch! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Data Mining & Web Scraping Automation (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) About the Research Institute: The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) conducts applied research into spatial data systems, automated data extraction, and infrastructure transformation. We build scalable data pipelines to turn fragmented public records into structured spatial insights. What We Offer: We fully sponsor and support your relocation journey to Germany via the Opportunity Card framework, managing visa formalities, degree assessments, and onboarding logistics. You will benefit from organized accommodation, living allowances during training, sponsored German language classes, and hands-on exposure to production-grade data mining environments. Your Role & Key Tasks: You will design, develop, and maintain autonomous scraping routines and extraction agents for public registers, corporate filings, and official announcements. We look forward to reviewing your application! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Geospatial Data Engineering & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
jobs.description: Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) About the Research Institute: The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is a non-profit, applied research institute dedicated to developing cutting-edge spatial resilience data models and open-data architectures for the energy transition, critical infrastructure, and sustainable regional planning. What We Offer: We provide comprehensive administrative support for international candidates, including full assistance with the German Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), degree recognition, and visa procedures. You will receive structured onboarding, local accommodation support, coverage of basic living expenses during training, on-site sponsored German language courses, and access to a modern data engineering tech stack centered on Python, PostGIS, Docker, and GIS platforms. Your Role & Key Tasks: In this role, you will build and maintain automated Python-based spatial data pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms. You will implement spatial overlay and inference models for energy grid matching and land-use analysis, while validating, structuring, and transforming vector geometries into our central PostgreSQL and PostGIS databases. Candidate Profile & Qualifications: We welcome applicants with a completed university degree in Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical discipline. You should bring practical experience or a strong learning interest in Python (GeoPandas, Shapely), SQL databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS), spatial reference systems, and automated data ingestion workflows. High motivation and fluent English skills are required. How to Apply: Please submit your CV along with a short cover letter in English. We look forward to welcoming you to the IRIS team! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)
